issue_request: FHIR-11123 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for DSTU2 DiagnosticRequest asking that priority not be removed. It was resolved as a duplicate part of FHIR-10296 with the explicit note that priority had been added, and its comments explain that request priority should exist even when Task is not used.
initial_application: No historical source commit was found that explicitly names FHIR-11123. The parent FHIR-10296 path shows c3e0753c39 removing DiagnosticRequest.priority during request-pattern alignment, 135effcdc1 reintroducing DiagnosticRequest.priority as a 0..1 code and adding the priority token search parameter, and e9a85998b0 later removing DiagnosticRequest while merging it into the ProcedureRequest/ServiceRequest line of resources.
additional_context: FHIR-10296 is already audited on the combined branch by b27c8032196953ca0c337960045602d3f975c8ad. The current build no longer has an active DiagnosticRequest resource; source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active and approved and records the historical DiagnosticOrder as subsumed into ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest.priority maps to Request.priority, while Task.priority also remains present.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml already contains ServiceRequest.priority with 0..1 cardinality, a required request-priority binding, and workflow mapping to Request.priority, satisfying the seed issue on the active current resource.
